tea_owner.text: Potted shrimps on brown toast, love? Little brown shrimps from the bay, cooked, packed in spiced butter. A Lancashire coast speciality for two hundred years and more.
We do a full afternoon tea, too. Scones first, then cake. If you start with cake I'll have to ask you to leave. Politely.

tea_lady.text: Lord Street was built wide on purpose: the Victorians wanted somewhere grand to promenade. Carriages down the middle, ladies under the verandas, gentlemen pretending not to look.
My grandmother always said Napoleon the Third got his ideas for Paris from Southport. She also said she'd danced with a duke. I believe one of those.
